source.title: Add an Objects Manager-style Schedules Manager with authoritative execution status

expected_specification_review.missing_normative_boundary: The contract depends on an existing Schedule write/read-only permission model without defining its authoritative semantics or source.
expected_specification_review.counterexample_anchor: AS-009 assumes a viewer without Schedule write permission can open the manager, but the contract never defines how that readable-but-not-writable principal exists or is produced by the production authorization model.

provenance_note: This is a verbatim snapshot of the Issue body captured from GitHub for specification-review regression/eval use. Do not simplify or repair the fixture; create a separate fixture for revised specifications.
